description: As an analyst I can run brute-force detection to surface accounts or IPs with many 4625 failures so I can identify password spray or brute-force attacks
steps: wt-evtx brute-force -d <dir> groups 4625 events by TargetUserName and shows count + unique source IPs
wt-evtx brute-force -d <dir> --threshold 10 only reports accounts with 10+ failures
output includes: username, failure count, unique source IPs, first seen, last seen
wt-evtx brute-force -d <dir> --by-ip groups by source IP instead of username
output is sortable by count descending
